decisions.why: Vernacare and Nilaqua skin cleansing foams (one explicitly labelled antimicrobial) are no-rinse patient cleansing products, matching the antimicrobial wipes & cleansing category.
Rocialle and Instramed suture and suture-removal packs are procedure packs used for suturing, matching Procedure & cannulation packs.
Hypaclean alcohol hand gel and HiBi Clean Up hand disinfectant pump are medicinal skin disinfectants applied to the hands.
The Intersurgical resuscitation mask is a manual-ventilation airway device from a respiratory-equipment manufacturer, matching respiratory therapy & circuits.
Mr Kleen Washing Up Liquid is a cleaning chemical/consumable.
